name: Tori 03 · Dispatch calendar + WhatsApp
description: Executes outbox jobs written by the booking transaction: Google Calendar create/update/delete and WhatsApp messages. Runs every 30 s (retries) and whenever 01/02/04/05 call it.

parameters.content:
## 03 · Dispatch calendar + WhatsApp
`tori.claim_jobs()` leases due jobs (SKIP LOCKED, safe to run in parallel) and says what to do from the **current** booking state.

- Calendar: deterministic event IDs → retries never duplicate. Create → 409 → overwrite. Delete → 404/410 = already gone.
- WhatsApp: text (dev) or approved templates (prod).

`tori.complete_job()` retries with backoff, alerts Ravi on 403/404 and dead jobs.

parameters.query: SELECT job FROM tori.claim_jobs(25) AS job;
